summary: Lument Finance Trust filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, disclosing that on October 1, 2026 it received NYSE notice it had regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum share price standard under Section 802.01C, based on a 30-trading-day average price through September 30, 2026 exceeding the threshold. Common stock (LFT) and 7.875% Series A preferred (LFTPrA) remain listed, subject to continued listing standards. No board recommendation, advisor, or consideration terms are stated. The cure removes near-term delisting risk, though the 30-day average test leaves little cushion — watch for renewed sub-$1 pricing and any subsequent deficiency notice.
